subgoals: Write the curl in three dimensions
Explain why each component is planar

visual.title: Each component is planar
visual.caption: The vortex field has a single component of curl because it lies in one plane. In three dimensions each component of the curl is the planar curl of the other two components.

predict.question: How does the three-dimensional curl treat its components?
options: Only the z component is ever nonzero
Each component is a planar curl in the plane normal to it
predict.explain: curl F = (∂R/∂y − ∂Q/∂z, ∂P/∂z − ∂R/∂x, ∂Q/∂x − ∂P/∂y). Each entry differentiates the two components in the plane normal to that axis.
